economic_thesis: Liquid native-crypto perpetuals incorporate common shocks first; heterogeneous delayed response in the remaining point-in-time Top-40 creates a cost-aware next-interval long/short diffusion spread, while idiosyncratic overshoot and funding crowding support chop.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Negative slow trend increases short gross and negative leader shocks identify delayed downside followers.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Positive slow trend increases long gross and positive leader shocks identify delayed upside followers.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Balanced sleeves use residual overshoot reversion and funding crowding after two-way shocks.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Owns the strongest positive diffusion gaps and under-reactions; expected to contribute in bull.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Owns the weakest diffusion gaps and over-reactions; expected to contribute in bear.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Winsorized shocks and organizer risk controls reduce tail gross; stress must remain within drawdown and worst-regime gates.

falsifier: Reject if stitched OOF development misses any frozen gate, propagation ablation is not worse, required regime/role signs fail, or the declared neighborhood is unstable.
mechanism: Dynamic liquid-leader basket; rolling contemporaneous-beta residualization; nonnegative one-bar lag response to the latest closed leader shock; small idiosyncratic reversal and past-funding carry; two-sided cross-sectional ranks with bounded slow-trend side tilt.
risk_policy_plan: Run the center once with top-level no-control risk_policy.json before every other material configuration. Volatility-only, drawdown-only, position-stop-only, turnover-only, and combined policies remain dormant unless the no-control core has positive base- and doubled-cost return/Sharpe, at least four positive folds, positive bull/bear/chop returns, positive long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop attribution, and active sleeves. Controls cannot rescue failure. Before any later policy commit, registration, and run, copy its immutable risk_policies template byte-for-byte to root risk_policy.json because the frozen lifecycle reads only that path.
selection_metric: All non-compensatory development gates, then highest stitched OOF net Sharpe among stable candidates; no failed candidate advances.

economic_thesis: Persistent common crypto moves provide a causal bull/bear directional forecast, while residual medium/slow strength, short reversal, and past funding carry provide a distinct two-sided relative opportunity whose blend adapts to fast/slow trend agreement.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Aligned negative common trend increases short gross, and the relative sleeve shorts persistent residual weakness while retaining active longs.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Aligned positive common trend increases long gross, and the relative sleeve owns persistent residual strength while retaining active shorts.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Fast/slow disagreement reduces net exposure and shifts the relative blend toward three-bar residual reversal and funding carry.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Owns the highest returned common-plus-relative forecasts and should carry bull plus relative-recovery attribution.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Shorts the lowest returned common-plus-relative forecasts and should carry bear plus relative-fade attribution.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Median aggregation, bounded transforms, broad sleeves, and a 0.04 coin cap limit outlier concentration; profitability remains an empirical gate.

falsifier: Reject if the exact no-control reference has nonpositive aggregate or doubled-cost return or Sharpe; nonpositive bull, bear, or chop return or Sharpe; failed long-bull, short-bear, or combined-chop attribution; fewer than four profitable folds; positive-quarter fraction below 0.55; incomplete A5 score coverage; nonpositive pooled score IC or fewer than four positive fold ICs; inactive sleeves; or positive-PnL concentration above 0.40. Controls, neighbors, and private data cannot rescue it.
mechanism: Every 48 hours, form a common crypto state from median 8-hour returns, 21/126-bar bounded trend, and 21-bar sign breadth. Blend 21/63-bar median-residual trend with three-bar residual reversal according to fast/slow trend agreement, add small past-funding carry, center-rank the relative forecast, add the common state, capture once at A5, and construct broad two-sided sleeves from only the returned scores.
risk_policy_plan: Run only the exact disabled no-control pivot reference first. No risk control, stop, neighbor, or private ticket is authorized unless that reference passes every broad alpha, regime, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, concentration, score-IC, and coverage gate. Controls cannot repair a failed mechanism.
selection_metric: Noncompensatory eligibility first: every no-control and score-evidence gate must pass. No controlled or neighboring result can substitute for the exact reference.

economic_thesis: Coins that persistently lead or lag the pure-crypto cross-section on both common-market up and down bars exhibit durable relative strength or weakness; requiring agreement across three time blocks should preserve that spread through bull, bear, and chop while a weekly neutral book controls cost at the mechanism level.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The neutral book owns coins with durable relative resilience on down as well as up bars and shorts persistent laggards without requiring a market-direction forecast.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The long sleeve owns persistent cross-tape relative leaders and the short sleeve retains persistent laggards while net exposure remains zero.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Three-block agreement and cross-tape shrinkage suppress transient one-window winners, reversal noise, and tape-dependent rankings.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Owns the highest returned durability ranks, requiring sustained peer outperformance across market directions and time blocks.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Shorts the lowest returned durability ranks, requiring sustained peer underperformance across market directions and time blocks.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Per-bar ranks, smaller-magnitude cross-tape scoring, broad neutral sleeves, 0.36 gross, and a 0.025 coin cap limit scale and beta concentration; profitability remains an empirical gate.

falsifier: Reject if this exact no-control core fails any official central-development threshold: net Sharpe at least 0.75, positive annualized return, Calmar at least 0.40, maximum drawdown at most 0.30, doubled-cost Sharpe at least 0.35, positive doubled-cost return, trial-adjusted probability positive at least 0.90, four profitable folds, positive-quarter fraction at least 0.55, worst-regime Sharpe at least -0.25, and at least three positive regime Sharpes; or fails any stricter bull, bear, chop, role, sleeve, concentration, A5 coverage, or score-IC gate. Controls, neighbors, and private data cannot rescue it.
mechanism: Every seven days, rank each eligible coin's return on each of 126 completed 8-hour bars. Reward relative leaders and laggards whose mean ranks agree across common-market up/down tapes and across three non-overlapping 42-bar blocks; shrink tape disagreement and time dispersion; final-rank once at A5; then construct a broad, equal-dollar, exactly neutral long/short book from only the returned scores.
risk_policy_plan: Run only the exact disabled no-control second-pivot reference first. No risk control, stop, neighbor, diagnostic, or private ticket is authorized unless that reference passes the complete official central-development gate and every stricter broad alpha, regime, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, concentration, score-IC, and coverage gate. Controls cannot repair a failed mechanism.
selection_metric: Noncompensatory eligibility first: the complete official central-development gate and every stricter no-control and score-evidence gate must pass. No controlled or neighboring result can substitute for the exact reference.
